name: Kris Van Dijck - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2024/823 of 28 February 2024 on exceptional trade measures for countries and territories participating in or linked to the Stabilisation and Association Process
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the European Commission's plan to extend special trade measures for the Western Balkans until 2030. These measures let countries in the region sell certain farm products to the EU with lower or no duties. The current rules were due to expire. The extension keeps existing trade benefits in place, removes an outdated reference to fisheries, and clarifies the rules on when benefits can be suspended. Parliament made no changes to the proposal.

- The EU keeps lower trade duties for Western Balkan fruit, vegetables and wine until 2030.
- It affects farm producers and traders in Western Balkan countries and the EU.
- Parliament adopted its position; talks with EU governments come next.
